**Source map — AMLO 20 Sep 2022 morning press conference (PREZ-005, units 1–41)**
Executive self-report; speech transcript. Labels: `[R]`=rhetoric/self-report, `[C]`=official-figure/self-report, `[D]`=directive/announcement, `[Q]`=journalist question. All claims should be verified against official sources before use.

**5B.5 / 5B.7 — Anti-corruption & oversight institutions**
- President calls INAI, Cofece, INE "andamiaje" of neoliberal period, accuses INAI of first-act secrecy on tax-condonation files and hiding Odebrecht info; says these bodies should be reformed, not abolished, via constitutional reform. `[R]` units 26–28.
- States "costs us a lot" regarding INAI; reporter cites INAI using personal-data claims to sanction journalists/media. `[Q]` unit 25.
- Cites reform of CFE gas pipeline contracts (renegotiated before the gas crisis, now shifting from losses to profits). `[R]` unit 37.

**5B.6 — Infrastructure/health spending (self-reported)**
- Health plan "IMSS-Bienestar" coverage figures (Nayarit 100% specialists, 98.6% prescriptions; Tlaxcala, Colima similar). Rehabilitation investments: Nayarit 237M MXN, Tlaxcala 157M, Colima 130M. Equipment acquisitions pending 3 Oct fallos. `[C]` units 2–6.
- Productivity gains vs pre-IMSS-Bienestar baselines (consultations +1,924%; surgeries +154% in Nayarit; +6,703% diabetes tests in Colima). `[C]` units 4–6.
- 19 Sep 2022 7.7M earthquake, epicenter Coalcomán, Michoacán; 692 aftershocks by 7:00; 2 deaths in Manzanillo; ~153 homes affected, schools, hospitals, bridges. DN-III/Marina/Guardia Nacional plans activated. `[C]` units 22–25.
- Guardia Nacional: 118,188 personnel; 242 of 594 planned companies built; 128,233 year-end target. `[C]` units 11–13.

**5B.4 / 5B.6 — Trade, investment, energy infrastructure**
- Pemex Consejo (10 Aug 2022) approved Dos Bocas refinery budget up to US$12 bn (not US$20 bn); ~US$1.8 bn additional associated works (gas pipeline >75 km, Paraíso road); ~US$750M commissioning tests. Reportedly tax-exclusive. `[R]/[Q]` units 31–33.
- Coquizadora Tula: ~US$2 bn additional to complete; Lakach gas field (US$2 bn sunk) now joint venture; Talos block returned to Pemex (~150,000 b/d potential). `[R]` units 35–36.
- Sonora investments "≈30 bn MXN": Yaqui aqueduct/irrigation district ~10 bn; Guaymas port + Chihuahua highway 3,927M; Nogales railroad relocation 6,500M; Peñasco solar (5 plants). Plan Sonora (lithium, batteries, auto industry). `[R]/[C]` units 38–41.

**5B.1 — Security & economy agenda framing**
- "Estrategia Nacional de Seguridad" attributed to "atención a las causas"; 23.3% federal-incidence drop; homicide -14.6% (lowest August in 5 yrs); kidnapping -73.5%; fuel theft from 72,000 b/d to 5,800 b/d (-91.9%), savings 226 bn MXN since 1 Dec 2018. Caseta Segura 35,926M MXN saved 2020–22. `[C]` units 6–9.
- Foreign-vehicle regularization: 557,697 vehicles vs 500,000 goal by 19 Sep; 1,394M MXN raised; 19 Mar–19 Sep window; decree extending to 31 Dec, Jalisco added. `[C]/[D]` units 9–10.
- Migration: 124,300 rescues in 86 days (+115% vs prior 86-day period). `[C]` unit 22.

**Limitations & contrary material**
- All figures are self-reported; many are ministerial/institutional statistics presented verbally. Independent verification needed (CNI/Sedena figures, INEGI crime stats, Pemex audited financials, SHCP budget docs, 2023 PEF etiquetados).
- President frames opposition coverage of Dos Bocas as a "campaña de desprestigio" without citing competing documentation.
- Earthquake damage figures described as preliminary ("mañana será con mayor precisión").

**Sections a stronger model should reopen**
- Units 31–37 (Dos Bocas budget detail, Pemex subsidiary extinction status, Talos/Lakach resolutions) — cross-check against Pemex financial statements and CNH rulings.
- Units 38–41 (Sonora budget allocations) — confirm against the published 2023 PEF and Ramo 33/Bienestar line items.
- Units 6–9 (homicide/kidnapping/fuel-theft trends) — compare with SNSP/INEGI monthly bulletins.
- INAI/Cofece statements (units 26–28) — verify with constitutional-reform status and COFECE plenary records.

**Token note**: Above map is ~860 tokens; content prioritized on 5B.5/5B.6/5B.4 (densest chapters represented). Continuation possible for full 5B.1–5B.10 coverage of the health/security/sismo sections if needed.
